name: FCC
_source: Reduced from FreeFCC's 21-frame fcc.json to ONE frame on 2026-08-19 by frame-subset experiments on RC 2 + Lito X1. See doc/fcc-minimal-sequence.md — this single write raised transmit power AND enabled 5.8 GHz, on the first apply, with no second round. The 21-frame original is kept beside this file as fcc_full.json.
_why_one_frame: The other 20 frames were removed in seven experiments (E1-E7), each verified against DJI Fly's Transmission page. The profile resisted per-frame shrinking for so long because power is reachable by TWO independent paths — the radio core (RADIO region/commit + SDR registers) and this WIFI channel-group write — so dropping any single frame left the effect standing.
_removed_repeats: rounds was 2 and Apply FCC followed the profile with a ce_regulatory_level=01 write. Both are gone: the second round is a duplicate of the first, and that parameter never stuck (reads back ff whether FCC is on or off — measured 2026-08-19, doc/fcc-autoapply-tests.md).

frames.note: WIFI channel group — the whole switch
